Definition: to bend the knee; by implication, to sink, to prostrate
BiblicalUsage: Kara is to bend the knee — to sink down, to prostrate oneself, whether in prayer or in worship or in fear. Solomon arose from before the altar, from kneeling on his knees with his hands spread up to heaven; God tells Elijah He has reserved seven thousand who have not bowed the knee to Baal; and Isaiah hears the LORD swear that unto Him every knee shall bow.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the knee is the body's confession. Solomon knelt to pray, the seven thousand refused to kneel to Baal, and one day every knee will bow to the Lord — and I have decided to bow mine now, willingly.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
